integrity: The global upper bound and full labeled census come from exhaustive traversal of all 9,765,625 ordered transition pairs. Canonical representative distances and the 240-element symmetry orbit are checked separately; the exhaustive program is replayed from the packaged source.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact result only for complete binary automata on five states; no unrestricted-alphabet or general-n claim.
A 2026 artifact advertises finite restricted-class enumerations, but its technical supplement was inaccessible; possible overlap in that restricted subclass remains a residual originality risk.
title: The five-state binary triple-rendezvous extremal is unique
